description: How is eight-ball played? The seven rules this game enforces: the break from behind the head string, the open table until the first called pot, calling the ball and the pocket, what counts as a foul, ball in hand anywhere as the penalty, the eight last and only in the called pocket, and what loses the frame. No arguments. THESE ARE THIS GAME'S RULES - WPA eight-ball as the simulation applies it, not the full WPA rule book. For a tournament question cite https://wpapool.com/rules-of-play/ alongside.
name: pool_rules
